title: A PILLAGER WITH A RARER COPY OF A GUN FIGHTS LIKE ONE WITH THE PLAIN GUN
why: Each pillagers fighting role (rusher, flanker, suppressor, marksman) is picked from the gun he carries, but the rarer copy of a gun has its own name, so it was not recognised and the role fell to a random pick: a pillager with a rarer Shotgun could come out as a suppressor, one with a rarer Support MG as a rusher. Proven in the cloud: 60 pillagers each with the plain and the rarer copy of Magnum, Shotgun, Carbine, Support MG, Marksman Rifle, Whisper and Rifle; the plain guns always gave their own role, the rarer copies spread over all three random roles. The role now reads the rarer copy as the gun it is a copy of. Pillagers with plain guns are unchanged.
now: A pillager carrying a rarer copy of a gun now fights the way that guns carrier always does.
